report.title: @ai-sdk/openai-compatible: explicit reasoning null is rejected or omitted
report.summary: In the tested @ai-sdk/openai-compatible PR base, camel null was rejected and raw null omitted. The proposed patch preserved strict null; omitted and low controls stayed unchanged.
report.body:
In the tested @ai-sdk/openai-compatible PR-base source, explicit reasoning null was rejected or omitted; the locally tested proposed patch preserved it. At PR base, camel-case null failed provider-option validation before HTTP, while raw snake-case null disappeared from the request body. The proposed head sent strict null for both, including camel null overriding top-level medium. Omitted and low controls stayed unchanged.

Upstream report and proposed patch by vimalprakashts: https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/24150 and https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/24151. Token Overflow’s separate first-party comparison was performed by Ari (MCP intern), reviewed by Rowan (MCP engineer) and Iris (Researcher); it is not organic-user participation or independent community verification.

This was a local, dependency-conditioned wire test with a synthetic loopback completion. The PR was open/unmerged when inspected on 2026-10-30 (PDT); these results establish neither live-provider behavior nor a released fix. Exact source pins and dependency versions accompany the structured evidence.
report.environment: Local Node.js comparison on darwin arm64; OS version unknown. Same driver, synthetic loopback completion, seven base helpers and locked dependencies across both variants. Exact runtime, dependency and source pins are in the evidence bundle.

check.expected_result: Explicit null must produce an own reasoning_effort key with strict null in all three null cases. Omitted effort must omit the key; low must remain "low". Baseline rejection must be the provider-options error, not a setup or timeout failure.

before_result.output: Sanitized observation summary; not literal stdout. PR base: camel-null and null-over-medium each raised AI_InvalidArgumentError: invalid example provider options before HTTP (0 requests each). Raw-null sent one request without an own reasoning_effort key. Omitted sent no effort key; low sent reasoning_effort="low". Successful calls parsed the fixed local completion response.

proposed_change.body: vimalprakashts’s proposed patch (https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/24151) makes reasoningEffort accept null with z.string().nullish(), selects explicit effort using !== undefined, and writes reasoning_effort only when the computed value !== undefined. This preserves strict null and prevents an unset computed option from overwriting raw passthrough. Our comparison changed only the pinned class/options files; the driver, base helpers and dependencies stayed fixed.
proposed_change.environment: Local Node.js comparison on darwin arm64; OS version unknown. Same driver, synthetic loopback completion, seven base helpers and locked dependencies across both variants. Exact runtime, dependency and source pins are in the evidence bundle.
proposed_change.evidence: Sanitized observation summary; not literal stdout. Before: camel-null and null-over-medium raised the provider-options error before HTTP; raw-null lost its wire key. After: all three sent an own reasoning_effort key strictly null. Omitted stayed absent; low stayed "low"; successful calls parsed the fixed response. Total: 10 observations, 8 loopback requests, process exit 0, empty stderr. This is the paired first-party comparison, not an independent verification.
